NONE: › written abbreviation for bring your own bottle: used on a party invitation to request that guests bring their own alcoholic drinks
（用於派對請柬中）請自帶飲料，請自帶酒水（bring your own bottle的縮寫）

› written abbreviation for bring your own device: the practice of companies or schools saying that employees or students can bring their own computers, phones, etc. to work or school in order to do their work on them
自備（計算機、電話等）工具（bring your own device的縮寫）

example: BYOD is here to stay, but security remains an issue that needs to be urgently addressed.
自備工具是長期政策，但是因此帶來的安全問題必須馬上解決。
